title: Billie Eilish & Finneas’ New John Hardy Collection Takes ‘Wildflower’ From Soft Florals to Chunky Chains
summary: The duo's latest creative collaboration goes beyond music, with jewelry pieces available Oct. 21.
contentText:

Billie Eilish and Finneas have made plenty of hits together, but their latest collaboration is something you can actually wear.

The Grammy-winning siblings have teamed up with John Hardy for their first co-designed jewelry collection, available as of Wednesday, Oct. 21, at JohnHardy.com , John Hardy stores and select retailers. The collection features rings, necklaces, bracelets and earrings that reflect their very different approaches to personal style.

Shop Billie Eilish & Finneas x john hardy collection 2026

The lineup is split into two distinct styles. Wildflower, named after Eilish’s Grammy-winning song from Hit Me Hard and Soft , takes a softer approach with sterling silver flowers , delicate pendants and lab-grown diamonds. There’s even a triple ring stack that brings three floral designs together, plus threader earrings that can be worn through multiple piercings.

Screwball, meanwhile, is where things get a little edgier. Chunky chain necklaces, sculptural bracelets and piercing-inspired hardware bring an industrial feel to the collection, offering a contrast to Wildflower’s more delicate designs.

Billie Eilish and Finneas behind the scenes in a John Hardy design meeting.

John Hardy

And this wasn’t a case of simply putting two famous names on a jewelry collection. The siblings spent the past year working closely with John Hardy’s New York and Bali design teams, helping develop the pieces from initial concepts to finished designs. Sustainability also played a role, with reclaimed metals and lab-grown diamonds incorporated into the collection.

“Jewelry has always been an enormous part of how I express myself,” Eilish said in a statement. “In my current day to day, I wear daintier jewelry. On tour, I love a chunkier, thicker piece. I love that we were able to work with both styles.”

EASY TO STYLE

BILLIE EILISH & FINNEAS X JH Wildflower Stud Earrings

Sterling Silver

$195

Buy Now at john Hardy

These sterling silver studs feature carved petals that give the floral design a three-dimensional look. They’re part of the Wildflower collection, inspired by Eilish’s Grammy-winning song of the same name.

BEST FOR LAYERING

BILLIE EILISH & FINNEAS X JH Wildflower Pendant Necklace

Sterling Silver, Lab-Grown Diamond

$695

The Wildflower pendant measures 15.7 millimeters and combines sculpted sterling silver petals with 0.1 carats of lab-grown diamonds. It hangs from an adjustable rolo chain.

DELICATE DESIGN

BILLIE EILISH & FINNEAS X JH Wildflower Stacking Rings Set of 3

$550

This isn’t your typical matching ring set. Each of the three sterling silver bands has a different sculpted flower design, allowing you to stack them together or mix them with other jewelry.

BEST SILVER LINK NECKLACE

BILLIE EILISH & FINNEAS X JH Screwball Link Necklace

$2,400

Unlike the delicate Wildflower pieces, this necklace leans into the collection’s tougher side with substantial silver links. The handcrafted design uses more than 99% reclaimed sterling silver.

BEST SPLURGE-WORTHY JEWELRY

BILLIE EILISH & FINNEAS X JH Screwball Link Bracelet

Part of the Screwball lineup, this $695 bracelet pairs sculptural silver links with an industrial-inspired silhouette. It’s handcrafted from reclaimed sterling silver and finished with a lobster clasp.

BILLIE EILISH & FINNEAS X JH Screwball Open Ring

$295

At $295, this is one of the more understated pieces in the Screwball collection. The open ring is handcrafted from sterling silver with a 5.5mm-wide band.

The launch also gives “Wildflower” another moment in the spotlight. The track appears on Eilish’s Hit Me Hard and Soft , which peaked at No. 2 on the Billboard 200 and also produced the Billboard Hot 100 hit “Birds of a Feather.” Eilish performed “Wildflower” throughout her Hit Me Hard and Soft world tour, which wrapped in November 2025.
